features.name: Project Setup & Verification Baseline
features.description: Confirm the project installs dependencies, runs verification (lint/test/build), and starts from a clean checkout.

features.name: Dashboard with Inactive Client Alerts (7–10 days)
features.description: PT sees a dashboard listing clients and a prominent alert if a client has had no sessions in the last 7–10 days.

features.name: Client Management (Add, Edit, Delete)
features.description: PT can add a new client, edit client information, and remove a client from the list.

features.name: Workout & Session Schedule
features.description: PT can create a workout session for a client and view upcoming sessions in a schedule.

features.name: InBody Progress Tracking
features.description: PT can enter InBody metrics for a client and view progress history or a simple chart over time.

features.name: Interaction Notes
features.description: PT can add text notes to a client to record conversations or important reminders.

features.name: Smart Slot Availability & 1-Click Zalo Rescheduling
features.description: PT can check which standard daily slots are free or booked for today and tomorrow, then reschedule a client in one click with a ready-to-paste Zalo confirmation message.
features.evidence: 2026-11-16: `./init.sh` exited 0 and `npx zmp build` passed (528 modules). Browser smoke test: the inline "Đổi lịch nhanh" panel showed all 7 standard slots for Hôm nay/Ngày mai; rescheduled Trần Thị Bình to Ngày mai 09:00 - 10:00; confirmation banner and Zalo CTA appeared; client Zalo state updated (hasUnreadZalo=false, inactiveDays=0, lastZaloMessage set); the new session survived a reload via sessionStorage; /workouts showed the slot as booked; exactly one scroll container remained.

features.name: Add Session from Empty Slot (End-to-End Flow)
features.description: Clicking a free slot opens a fully controlled add-session form with shared prefill data, availability-aware time choices, workout-type presets, note input, validation, and immediate slot booking after save.
features.evidence: 2026-11-16: `./init.sh` exited 0 and `npx zmp build` passed (528 modules). Browser smoke test: free slot 09:00 - 10:00 (Hôm nay) opened /workout-add with the slot pre-selected; selected Phạm Thị Dung, clicked preset "Full Body tổng hợp", entered a note, saved; /workouts immediately showed the slot booked and a session card (Full Body tổng hợp, Buổi 4/12, Hôm nay); detail view showed exercises + note. Repeated for Ngày mai 06:30 - 07:30 with Hoàng Văn Em; matrix returned to Ngày mai and showed the booking. Empty workoutType triggered validation without adding a session. sessionStorage preserved both sessions after reload; no console errors.

features.name: Custom Date Picker & Exact-Date Slot Availability
features.description: PT can pick any calendar date beside Hôm nay / Ngày mai in the slot matrix, client reschedule panel, workout-card panel, and add-session form; availability matches the exact date.
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: `npx zmp build` passed (528 modules). Browser smoke test: selected 20/11/2026 in the renamed matrix 'Lịch trống & Ca dạy của PT' -> 7 free slots; added a session on 20/11/2026 at 09:00 -> slot became booked and the card appeared under 'Ngày khác'. Selected 15/10/2026 via the calendar -> matched the Hôm nay bookings (06:30 An, 18:00 Cường), proving ISO-date matching. Date input was highlighted with a blue border/ring while a custom date was active.

features.name: Inline Workout Rescheduling & Instant Tab Navigation
features.description: Each workout card has an inline 'Đổi lịch nhanh' panel with date/time selection and Zalo notification; top-level tab switches have zero animation while drill-down/back views use a 150ms fade-slide.
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: `npx zmp build` passed (528 modules). Browser smoke test: on the 20/11/2026 workout card, 'Đổi lịch nhanh' opened the inline panel; moved Phạm Thị Dung from 09:00 to 14:00; banner 'Đã chuyển lịch sang 14:00 - 15:00 (20/11/2026) & copy tin nhắn!' and 'Báo khách qua Zalo' appeared; matrix updated. Completed cards also expose the action. Client panel moved Trần Thị Bình to 01/12/2026 09:00. Tab click set nav_direction=tab and html.nav-instant=true with computed transitionDuration=0s and animationName=none; class removed after 450ms. Drill-down/back computed transitionDuration=0.15s with 32px translateX. No console errors; no scale/bounce hover classes remain.
